using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.common;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.tests
{
    public class CheckpointStoreTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_LogsIndexTokenDeletion_WhenIndexTokensDiffer()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<CheckpointStore>>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace)).Returns(true);
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>(It.IsAny<GarnetServerOptions>());
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>(It.IsAny<GarnetServerOptions>());
            
            var entry = new CheckpointEntry
            {
                metadata = new CheckpointMetadata
                {
                    storeHlogToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    storeIndexToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    objectStoreHlogToken = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    objectStoreIndexToken = Guid.NewGuid()
                }
            };

            var mockCkptManager = new Mock<IRecoveryCheckpointManager>();
            var indexTokens = new List<Guid> { Guid.NewGuid(), entry.metadata.storeIndexToken, Guid.NewGuid() };
            mockCkptManager.Setup(m => m.GetIndexCheckpointTokens()).Returns(indexTokens);
            mockCkptManager.Setup(m => m.DeleteIndexCheckpoint(It.IsAny<Guid>()));

            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(StoreType.Main)).Returns(mockCkptManager.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.serverOptions).Returns(new GarnetServerOptions { DisableObjects = true });

            // Create CheckpointStore - this will call PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry() in ctor if safelyRemoveOutdated=true
            // but we control the mocks so it should be safe
            var store = new CheckpointStore(mockStoreWrapper.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object, safelyRemoveOutdated: false, mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            store.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry(entry);

            // Assert
            mockCkptManager.Verify(m => m.DeleteIndexCheckpoint(It.Is<Guid>(t => !t.Equals(entry.metadata.storeIndexToken))), Times.Exactly(2));
            mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogTrace(
                    "Deleting index token {toDeleteIndexToken}", 
                    It.IsAny<Guid>()), 
                Times.Exactly(2));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_DoesNotLogIndexTokenDeletion_WhenNoIndexTokensDiffer()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<CheckpointStore>>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace)).Returns(true);
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>(It.IsAny<GarnetServerOptions>());
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>(It.IsAny<GarnetServerOptions>());
            
            var entry = new CheckpointEntry
            {
                metadata = new CheckpointMetadata { storeIndexToken = Guid.NewGuid() }
            };

            var mockCkptManager = new Mock<IRecoveryCheckpointManager>();
            mockCkptManager.Setup(m => m.GetIndexCheckpointTokens()).Returns(new List<Guid> { entry.metadata.storeIndexToken });
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(StoreType.Main)).Returns(mockCkptManager.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.serverOptions).Returns(new GarnetServerOptions { DisableObjects = true });

            var store = new CheckpointStore(mockStoreWrapper.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object, safelyRemoveOutdated: false, mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            store.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry(entry);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                l => l.LogTrace(
                    It.Is<string>(s => s.Contains("Deleting index token")), 
                    It.IsAny<object[]>()), 
                Times.Never);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry_DoesNotLog_WhenTraceDisabled()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<CheckpointStore>>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace)).Returns(false);
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>(It.IsAny<GarnetServerOptions>());
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>(It.IsAny<GarnetServerOptions>());
            
            var entry = new CheckpointEntry { metadata = new CheckpointMetadata { storeIndexToken = Guid.NewGuid() } };

            var mockCkptManager = new Mock<IRecoveryCheckpointManager>();
            var indexTokens = new List<Guid> { Guid.NewGuid(), Guid.NewGuid() };
            mockCkptManager.Setup(m => m.GetIndexCheckpointTokens()).Returns(indexTokens);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(StoreType.Main)).Returns(mockCkptManager.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(p => p.serverOptions).Returns(new GarnetServerOptions { DisableObjects = true });

            var store = new CheckpointStore(mockStoreWrapper.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object, safelyRemoveOutdated: false, mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            store.PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry(entry);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogTrace(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.Never);
        }
    }
}

    // Wrapper to test the internal method behavior
    public class CheckpointStoreWithMockedDeps
    {
        private readonly ILogger logger;
        private readonly IClusterProvider clusterProvider;

        {
            this.clusterProvider = clusterProvider;
            this.logger = logger;
        }

        public void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptEntry(object entry)
        {
            if (entry == null) return;
            PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptTokens(StoreType.Main, Guid.Empty, Guid.Empty);
            if (!clusterProvider.serverOptions.DisableObjects)
                PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptTokens(StoreType.Object, Guid.Empty, Guid.Empty);

            void PurgeAllCheckpointsExceptTokens(StoreType storeType, Guid logToken, Guid indexToken)
            {
                var ckptManager = clusterProvider.GetReplicationLogCheckpointManager(storeType);

                // Simplified to test just the index token logging path
                foreach (var toDeleteIndexToken in ckptManager.GetIndexCheckpointTokens())
                {
                    if (!toDeleteIndexToken.Equals(indexToken))
                    {
                        logger?.LogTrace("Deleting index token {toDeleteIndexToken}", toDeleteIndexToken);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public enum StoreType { Main, Object }
